keystate_helper_path.markdownDescription:
Path to the `tabstack-keystate` helper that detects Ctrl releases on Linux.

It is used whenever it works, and it is required under native Wayland.

show_wayland_setup_dialog.markdownDescription:
Offer the helper's setup instructions on the first `ctrl+tab` per plugin load when Ctrl-release detection is unavailable under native Wayland.

The dialog's "Don't Ask Again" button sets this to `false`.
